cohort: This study included 635 very low birth weight (VLBW) preterm infants from the Central University Hospital of Asturias.
finding: While Fenton and IW-21 showed good concordance for IUGR diagnosis, IW-21 identified a smaller proportion of infants with EUGR, who were more likely to experience neonatal morbidity, especially when using the dynamic EUGR definition.
